# Reza Babaei

> Reza Babaei, P.Eng., CEM, CMVP, LEED Green Associate — Energy Engineer, TELUS @ BGIS, and Research Scientist at the University of Windsor (Turbulence & Energy Laboratory). Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Works on building decarbonization, HVAC optimization, telecommunications and data centre energy efficiency, and measurement and verification.

## Key facts

- Name: Reza Babaei
- Current title: Energy Engineer, TELUS @ BGIS (BGIS, on the TELUS portfolio)
- Research role: Research Scientist, University of Windsor, Turbulence & Energy Laboratory
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Credentials: Professional Engineer (P.Eng., Professional Engineers Ontario); Certified Energy Manager (CEM) and Certified Measurement and Verification Professional (CMVP), Association of Energy Engineers; LEED Green Associate, U.S. Green Building Council
- Education: University of Windsor; University of Mazandaran
- Awards: EM Honours 2026 (Energy Manager Canada); T&E Lab Techno-Economist 2026 (University of Windsor); T&E Lab Furious Scribbler 2026 (University of Windsor); Top Research Publisher of 2025 (University of Windsor)
- Topics: decarbonization, net-zero buildings, HVAC optimization, telecom and data centre energy efficiency, building automation systems, electrification, energy retrofits, measurement and verification, renewable energy systems, green hydrogen, energy modelling
